{{Short description|American biomathematics professor}}
'''Richard Bertram''' is a [[mathematician]] who works in the field of biomathematics. He is an [[endowed professor]] and head of the biomathematics program at Florida State University and a fellow of the [[Society for Mathematical Biology]] (SMB).

==Education==
Bertram earned his Bachelors degree and Ph.D at Florida State University. He completed his Ph.D in 1993 under supervisor Jeronimo Magnan.<ref>{{cite web |title=Richard Bertram - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=1852 |access-date=26 September 2025 |website=www.mathgenealogy.org}}</ref>

==Career==
In 2010 Bertram was named director of the Florida State University biomathematics program.<ref name="CV">{{cite web |last1=Bertram |first1=Richard |title=Curriculum Vitae |url=https://www.math.fsu.edu/~bertram/cv/mycv_25.pdf |access-date=26 September 2025 |website=math.fsu.edu}}</ref> Beginning in 2014, he spent ten years as deputy editor for ''[[Mathematical Biosciences]]'', a peer-reviewed [[academic journal]] published by [[Elsevier]]. In 2017, the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] awarded Bertram the Outstanding Paper Prize for a paper with Theodore Vo and Martin Wechselberger.<ref>{{cite web |date=23 March 2018 |title=Prize Spotlight: Theodore Vo, Richard Bertram, and Martin Wechselberger |url=https://www.siam.org/publications/siam-news/articles/prize-spotlight-theodore-vo-richard-bertram-and-martin-wechselberger |website=Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Prize History SIAM Outstanding Paper Prizes |url=https://www.siam.org/programs-initiatives/prizes-awards/major-prizes-lectures/siam-outstanding-paper-prizes/prize-history/ |access-date=26 September 2025 |website=Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics}}</ref>

In 2023, he became a fellow of the [[Society for Mathematical Biology|SMB]]<ref>{{cite web |last1=Fulk |first1=Hannah |title=Putting a ‘spotlight’ on FSU: Biomathematics program director earns prestigious fellowship {{!}} College of Arts and Sciences |url=https://artsandsciences.fsu.edu/article/putting-spotlight-fsu-biomathematics-program-director-earns-prestigious-fellowship |website=artsandsciences.fsu.edu}}</ref> and the following year he was elected to the society's Board of Directors.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Wellock |first1=Bill |date=22 May 2024 |title=FSU mathematician elected to board of directors for renowned international scientific society |url=https://news.fsu.edu/news/science-technology/2024/05/22/fsu-mathematician-elected-to-board-of-directors-for-renowned-international-scientific-society/ |website=Florida State University News}}</ref>
